title: After the Satsuki Sho: Leaving Claw Marks

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: (I don't care how little progress I make, but I'm going to change! Even if it's just a smidge, I will change!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: I'LL SHOW YOU… THE REAL MEEEEE! HYAAAAH!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Even after exerting all of her strength, Mejiro Palmer is unable to win the Satsuki Sho.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Huff… Puff… Wheeze… I'm spent… That's enough running… for me today…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Palmer…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Oh. Ryan.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: You did really well. And I dunno know how to put it, but…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: You seem different. More serious… Or actually, it's more like you're scarier now.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Scarier?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Yeah. When we were kids, I never saw you make a grim face like the one you had on during the race.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Seeing you like that made me feel like you've changed.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Yeah, maybe… But…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: (Sorry. I haven't changed at all.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: (I just never showed my true self before. And now, I've finally lifted my mask a little…)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: I'm back! It felt awesome to really let loose out there, but…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: I couldn't really change Ryan's view much. I guess it's hard to convince people you aren't a Goody Two-shoes.
choice_data_list: But you still made an impression on her, right?
But you still made an impression on her, right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Yeah. I think I've changed a little in her eyes. She at least thinks I'm pretty good now.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: I've gotta keep boosting my vibes even more until they get through to everyone!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The image everyone has of Mejiro Palmer being a good little kid comes from old, sepia-toned memories from her childhood.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But she may have been able to change the hue of that image today, even just a little bit.
